signature.name: Space Center Houston
signature.detail: The official visitor center of NASA's Johnson Space Center, this is the one place in Houston that draws travelers from around the world, with real spacecraft and astronaut history on display. Book tickets online in advance and go early on weekday mornings to beat the crowds; it sits well south of downtown, so plan on a car or rideshare.

signature.name: Museum of Fine Arts, Houston
signature.detail: One of the largest art museums in the country, with a broad collection spanning antiquity to contemporary work across several buildings. It is closed on Mondays, so check hours before you go; the Museum District is easy to reach by light rail.

signature.name: Houston Zoo
signature.detail: A major zoo in Hermann Park with thousands of animals and a strong reputation for family visits. Arrive at opening in the cooler morning hours, and note that the zoo sits next to the light rail line in the Museum District.

signature.name: Hermann Park
signature.detail: A large green space in the heart of the Museum District, home to the zoo, gardens and a lake, and a natural stop between nearby museums. Go in the morning or late afternoon to avoid the heat; the park is served by the Metro light rail.

signature.name: Buffalo Bayou Park
signature.detail: A long stretch of trails, gardens and skyline views along the bayou just west of downtown, popular for walking and biking. Early morning or sunset gives the best light and cooler temperatures; rent a bike or walk in from nearby neighborhoods.

signature.name: The Galleria
signature.detail: Texas's best-known shopping destination, with hundreds of stores, dining and an indoor ice rink under one roof. It is busiest on weekends, so weekday mornings are calmer; parking is plentiful but rideshare avoids the garage hassle.

signature.name: Downtown Aquarium
signature.detail: An aquarium and entertainment complex downtown with exhibits and a Ferris wheel, good for families. Check exhibit hours before visiting and combine it with a walk around downtown; it is close to the theater district.

signature.name: Rice University
signature.detail: A handsome, walkable campus known for its architecture and tree-lined grounds in the Museum District. It is free to stroll; go on a weekday for a quieter visit and pair it with nearby Hermann Park.

transport: Metro light rail $1.25 a ride; rideshares moderate
